_comment_paths: Where Plaud staging files come from and where your vault lives. Absolute paths, or ~ for home.
_comment_fields: Frontmatter field names this tool reads from each Plaud summary. Change if your Plaud templates use different names.
_comment_routing: How the 'type' field maps to a vault folder, filename prefix, and naming style. Order doesn't matter; the first matching type wins. Any 'type' not listed here is parked in the inbox_folder. Available naming styles: 'one_on_one' (uses Participant), 'titled' (uses Short Title), 'journal' (YYYY-MM-DD_Journal.md), 'inbox' (YYYY-MM-DD_Inbox_<Title>.md).
_comment_naming: Knobs for the Short Title rule used by 'titled' routes.
_comment_self_participant: Names that count as 'yourself' in a 1-on-1. The first non-self participant becomes the filename.
_comment_indices: Your Obsidian index files. The templater (plaud-template-sync) reads these to find canonical [[wikilinks]] for every person, company, project, etc. Each index file should use H2 (## Heading) sections to group entries by category. Paths are relative to vault_root.
_comment_templates_note: A single markdown note in your vault where you keep your Plaud-side transcription templates. The templater only rewrites content between <!-- WIKILINK-RULES:<id> --> and <!-- /WIKILINK-RULES:<id> --> markers. You own the rest. Path is relative to vault_root.
_comment_templates: Which indices and which categories feed each template's wikilink-rules block. 'index' must match an id in 'indices' above. 'categories' lists the H2 section names to include from that index, or use '*' for all categories in the index.
_comment_corrections: Optional. Find-and-replace pairs applied to every wikilink-rules block after rendering. Useful when an index file has a name that should be normalised before reaching the Plaud device (e.g. uppercase vs canonical casing). Leave empty if you don't need it.
